verdict.rationale: Motion supports voice-to-task creation, email forwarding to tasks, and a documented REST API (verified live via probe with auth enforcement), but there is no evidence of a natural-language conversational interface or NL command layer for operating the product broadly (e.g., chat-based control, NL task/project management, or an LLM assistant embedded in the product). missing for 10: evidence of a natural-language/chat interface for controlling Motion, documented NL command parsing beyond voice-to-task, and independent confirmation of such a feature working.
